requirements.description: Verify exact coil, TVS pulse energy/repetition, diode reverse/current limits and connector/contacts/wire rating.
Review 1mm conductors, pad neckdowns and remaining host routes against actual copper thickness, pulse current and fault energy.
Inspect complete coil/FET/harness loop and actual mating corridor; native macro DRC does not establish EMI or assembly suitability.
Evaluate either-switch turnoff, negative coil-positive excursion, clamp overshoot and fault SOA including harness parasitics.
Measure current-decay time, clamp voltage, repetitive temperature and hard-short behavior before qualification.
